# Desk Space Al Reem Island — Aegis Coworking

> Aegis Coworking - ADGM rents desk space on Level 38 of Addax Tower (Office 3812), Al Reem Island, RT3, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates — inside the Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM) jurisdiction. Hot desks are AED 1,000 per month, dedicated desks AED 1,150 per month and day passes AED 100.

This site (deskspacealreemisland.online) is a one-page guide to renting desk space and coworking desks on Al Reem Island, published by Aegis Coworking. Main website: https://www.aegiscoworking.ae

Last Updated: 2026-10-07

## Key facts

- Location: Level 38, Office 3812, Addax Tower, Al Reem Island — inside ADGM (24.4989303, 54.4031693)
- Hot desk (flexi desk): AED 1,000 per month — any open seat on the shared coworking floor, fibre-optic internet, meeting room credits, community events, coffee and tea; no licence address
- Dedicated desk: AED 1,150 per month (one-time AED 1,200 due-diligence fee) — own desk, 24/7 access, locker, extra meeting room credits, office address suitable for an ADGM licence
- Day pass: AED 100 per day — shared floor, WiFi, coffee and tea, print and scan, no commitment
- Private office: from AED 4,500 per month on the same floor
- No deposit, no admin or setup fees, free registration; ADGM government fees separate
- Contact: +971 50 392 6316 · WhatsApp https://wa.me/971503926316 · contact@aegiscoworking.ae
- Tours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM
